# Code of conduct

Codex Partner should be a place where people can improve Windows developer tools
without having to defend their identity, experience level, language, or choice
of AI provider.

## Expected behavior

- Be specific about code and behavior; do not make criticism personal.
- Assume good faith while still asking for evidence, tests, and clear scope.
- Welcome questions from new contributors and explain project-specific context.
- Respect privacy. Do not repost credentials, account identity, private logs, or
  unrelated desktop content even when it appeared in an earlier report.
- Accept maintainer decisions about scope and release risk without harassment;
  technical disagreement and well-supported alternatives remain welcome.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, threats, discrimination, sexualized attention, doxxing, deliberate
misgendering, sustained disruption, spam, and publishing another person's
private information are not acceptable. Neither is using issue reports to
pressure maintainers into bypassing security, release, or review safeguards.

## Scope

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions,
release channels, and other spaces where someone is representing this project.

## Reporting and enforcement

For ordinary moderation, contact the repository owner through their GitHub
profile with links or screenshots of the relevant interaction. Do not prolong
the incident in the same public thread. For a security-sensitive report, use
the private process in [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

Maintainers may edit or remove content, issue a private warning, temporarily
limit participation, or permanently ban participation depending on severity,
impact, and repeated behavior. Reports will be handled as privately as the
platform permits; retaliation against a reporter is itself a violation.
